title: Strikes blamed on Houthis target Yemen presidential palace

blocks.text: ADEN, Yemen — Yemen’s Houthis targeted the presidential palace in Aden on Friday with two missiles, a police official told AFP, hours after Saudi forces said they had intercepted an attack by the group on the Gulf kingdom. Aden, the seat of Yemen’s Saudi-backed and internationally recognised government, has been targeted repeatedly since Yemen’s dormant civil war reignited in July. Two eyewitnesses told AFP they saw ambulances entering the palace in Aden, a large compound made up of several buildings including facilities used by government and Saudi-led coalition forces, after the incident.
